claim: In 2021, Ask Delphi, an AI-based website to which people could pose ethical or moral questions, received 3 million queries in a few weeks.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-13 - not yet checked by the human annotator] The New York Times (republished by Jordan News, updated 5 Dec 2021): 'Delphi, which has received more than 3 million visits over the past few weeks'; built by the Allen Institute for AI.
